note:
Trial 26 ended in death. The screen reads "TRIAL END: DEATH" with the message that I was shot by the skeleton.

What I saw:
- At the start, a skeleton stood ahead and a reddish mob with a weapon lay near the ground to the right. The red mob never reappeared after the fight began.
- The skeleton kept strafing and hitting me with arrows while I tried to close the distance. Health fell steadily from full to half a heart over about six actions, even with the shield raised.
- My final action was a forward charge with a sword swing. The screen showed the skeleton still standing nearby when the death screen appeared. I did not observe any kill.

Input problem: left turns were unreliable. Small negative dx values did not visibly rotate the view left, and the skeleton drifted off to the side each time, so I spent most of the fight facing slightly away from it with the shield not covering the arrow direction. Only a large negative dx of 250 produced a clear left turn.
